success_criteria: retention_policy, expired_export_cleanup, orphan_cleanup, and audit_refs all return 200 or 202
each response body is non-empty and matches the expected retention/cleanup/audit tokens
each response echoes the per-probe request ID in the configured request-id header
expired-export and orphan cleanup responses include cleanup audit refs
the audit endpoint contains those cleanup audit refs with admin, tenant, cleanup semantics, and the exact cleanup probe request IDs
the canonical pass report and NDJSON paths under ops/evidence/staging/ are used

runtime_input_requirements.blocked_input_reason: missing STAGING_BASE_URL or explicit probe URL env vars
runtime_input_requirements.pass_file_policy: canonical pass paths require passing evidence to be written to ops/evidence/staging/object-storage-retention-cleanup.json and ops/evidence/staging/object-storage-retention-cleanup.ndjson; non-canonical paths are validation-only.
runtime_input_requirements.required_auth: ADMIN_BEARER_TOKEN or ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE with admin_operator access
runtime_input_requirements.required_base_url: STAGING_BASE_URL or explicit probe URL env vars
runtime_input_requirements.required_csrf_header: X-Zenari-CSRF header with CSRF_HEADER_VALUE for state-changing object cleanup POST probes
runtime_input_requirements.required_csrf_origin: CSRF_ORIGIN, STAGING_ADMIN_URL, ADMIN_URL, STAGING_WEB_URL, or WEB_URL matching an allowed staging origin for POST cleanup probes
runtime_input_requirements.required_request_id_echo: each probe must send X-Request-ID and receive the same value in response headers
runtime_input_requirements.required_smoke_admin_tenant_id: SMOKE_ADMIN_TENANT_ID bound to the staging tenant whose objects and audit refs are probed
runtime_input_requirements.required_smoke_admin_user_id: SMOKE_ADMIN_USER_ID bound to the admin operator executing the cleanup probes
